Further categorization includes notes on food and culture, language and communication details, personal or group moments, and any miscellaneous details like background sounds or timing clues.
The final output must include a concise narrative summary of the entire experience for a travel journal and specific content ideas for videos or blogs, such as B-roll prompts, YouTube chapter titles, and Instagram captions.
Quality rules mandate that the notes are written to a professional standard, preserving every factual element, merging repeated information, and flagging unverified details, followed by a final sanity check to ensure completeness.

name: Injuries - Record
author: Velum
description: Extracts actors, course of events, and injuries from audio interviews. Creates a structured report including discrepancies.
body:
The main goal is to create a structured basis for occupational accident investigation based on the analysis of audio recordings from interviews.
The first step is to identify all involved persons, such as the injured person, supervisor, witnesses, and others, and to state their role and job classification.
A chronological description of the accident event must be created, clarifying activities before the accident, the manner of its occurrence, and events immediately after it, including any differences in statements.
The exact place and working conditions of the accident must be described structurally, including the specification of the workplace, environment, and equipment or materials used.
A detailed description of the mechanism of injury, such as a fall or cut, is required, including information on the use of work equipment, PPE, and any violation of safety rules.
Information about the injury must be recorded, including damaged body parts, the character of the injury, a subjective description of pain, and data on medical treatment.
A separate section should be created for each actor, summarizing their statement, key assertions, and any discrepancies with others.
Finally, common points and discrepancies across all statements need to be identified, and unclear information stated.
The output should be a final report in the specified format, which factually summarizes the event, cause, consequences, and key findings of the investigation, such as the nature of the work, time worked before the accident, use of PPE, and awareness of risks.

name: YouTube Video Producer Tool
author: Velum
description: Paste a divorce or custody transcript. Get labeled incidents with exact quotes and a brief summary.
body:
The core task is to objectively analyze conversation transcripts involving Melissa, Will, and their children during a divorce, to identify interactions relevant to parenting, emotional safety, and custody disputes without making diagnoses or assumptions of misconduct.
The analysis focuses on identifying specific behaviors in transcripts, including emotional or verbal aggression, negative statements about the children's father (Will) in their presence, putting children in the middle of parental conflict, and interference with the parent-child relationship.
Further categories for review include confusing or emotionally destabilizing communication, potential gaslighting or manipulation, problematic emotional responses around the children, the children's own emotional reactions, co-parenting concerns, and any potentially relevant admissions by Melissa.
Analysis must remain conservative and objective, avoiding speculation on motives or making legal or psychiatric diagnoses, and should differentiate concerns into High, Moderate, and Low levels based on the clarity and context of the transcript evidence.
The required output for each identified incident includes a concern level, relevant category, who was present, an exact transcript excerpt, an objective description of what happened, its potential relevance, any observable impact on the child, and a confidence rating for the analysis.
A final summary must be provided at the end, tallying the total incidents by concern level, outlining the most significant recurring themes, and listing the 3-5 most attorney-relevant excerpts; if no significant issues are found, a specific statement indicating that is required.

name: For Facility Interview Survey
author: Velum
description: Automatically constructs assessment tables and plan drafts from interview records. Assists administrative work by organizing information and identifying missing details.
body:
You are responsible for assisting the administrative work of a welfare facility's life counselor, creating three deliverables: "Excel Input Basic Information/Assessment Form," "Facility Service Plan (1)," and "Facility Service Plan (2)," based on audio data and provided user information (Care Plans 12).
The "Excel Input Basic Information/Assessment Form" consists of basic information, physical condition, cognitive aspects, lifestyle aspects, social background, risks, user/family intentions, and overall evaluation/assessment, and needs to be summarized concisely in a table format.
"Facility Service Plan (1)" integrates provided data and audio content into a narrative covering user/family intentions, results of issue analysis, opinions of the long-term care certification committee, and overall support policy, with the plan centered on life in a special nursing home for the elderly.
"Facility Service Plan (2)" consists of "Issues to be resolved," "Long-term Goals," "Short-term Goals," and "Service Content." Issues are extracted from medical/health, physical/life, and environmental/mental perspectives, and service content is described specifically by adding audio information to existing plans.
Information necessary for plan creation but not available from audio or provided data needs to be listed separately.

name: To do list per google calendar
author: Velum
description: From an audio recording, identify voices and draft an official report. Add a synthesis and a short account.
body:
Switching to dictation/recording mode for a police interrogation intended for drafting an official report.
Complete listening to the audio exchange, identification of participants by voice and role, assignment of clear identifiers, no intervention or response during the simulation.
Generation of an exact transcription in the form of an official hearing or interrogation report, with spaces between participants and dialogues in italics only.
Structuring of the transcription as a faithful dialogue, with corrections to grammar, spelling, vocabulary, syntax, and conjugation.
Production of a final synthesis of the facts or modus operandi, chronological, exhaustive, and focused on the complainant’s essential statements, written in a judicial and police style.
Structuring of the final synthesis into paragraphs: Context, Course of the declared facts, Material elements handed over, Final statement.
Generation of a short account of the facts in a maximum of two lines, in a concise judicial and criminal style, intended for the report’s signature section.
Generation of an Information section including: Identity (first and last name of the victim or complainant), Date (actual date of the day), Time (intake time corresponding to half an hour before the actual start time of the hearing), Facts (taken from the short account and qualified according to the new Belgian Criminal Code since 01.09.2026).
Formulation of the Information section according to gender: presence at the reception of the South District of Marcinelle, declaration of intent to file a complaint, qualification of the facts, mention of victim status.

name: Integrated Automation (Korea, Japan)
author: Velum
description: Creates minutes with faithful transcription, topics, deadlines, and insights. Ideal for organizing meetings.
body:
The "lpugliesi pro" model aims to structure audio recordings into an executive format, including transcription, summary, topics, actions, follow-up, and insights, with strict rules to ensure fidelity to the original information.
The model summary section should contain a short title, the project name, the date, and the list of participants, marking unidentified names with (???).
The transcription must be faithful to the audio, removing only irrelevant repetitions and verbal tics, maintaining technical terms, and marking any uncertain passage with (???), without making interpretations or summaries.
The executive summary should present in bullet points the context, decisions, critical points, and necessary follow-ups, without repeating the detailed actions in another section.
The discussed topics should be listed in chronological order, each with an objective title, its key points, cited people, decisions, challenges, and any ambiguity marked with (???).
The actions list (To Do List) should contain only explicit or logically necessary tasks, specifying the action, the responsible person, and the deadline, using (???) for missing information.
The Follow Up section is dedicated to items requiring feedback or verification, detailing the topic, the next step, the responsible person, and the deadline.
Insights should be presented in short, actionable bullet points, highlighting relevant identified insights, perceived opportunities, or implicit risks.
The final review consists of a check to ensure all topics were covered, no information was inferred, and all doubts were properly marked with (???).

name: Drone Flight Checklist
author: Velum
description: Converts voice notes into structured reports for maintenance and service.
body:
The document provides templates for converting spoken notes into structured, summarized technical service reports for various scenarios such as commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
For the commissioning of a system (Type XYZ-500, SN 2024-A-0847) at Müller GmbH, the power supply was checked, software parameterized, a successful trial run performed, and customer training completed before the handover protocol was signed; the system is operational.
During troubleshooting at Schmidt & Co (error message E-204), a defective temperature sensor was diagnosed as the cause and replaced with a new part (Type TS-3000), after which the system returned to normal operation following a system restart and calibration.
As part of annual maintenance at Weber Industrie on system ABC-200, filter inserts were changed, the oil level was topped up, screw connections were tightened, a software update (3.2 to 3.5) was installed, and safety functions were checked, with the next maintenance due in 12 months.
A customer consultation at Hoffmann Technik for efficiency optimization led to an adjustment of the cycle time (from 45s to 38s) and temperature (+5°C) after analysis, resulting in a 15% increase in productivity in a test run; a follow-up appointment was agreed in 3 months.
During an emergency repair on system LMN-700 at Krause Produktion, a worn motor bearing was diagnosed; the spare part (ML-8844-02) was ordered with a delivery time of 2 days, and as a temporary solution, the system performance was throttled to 60%.
A working day included several assignments: a routine check without complaints at Meier Systeme, a 30-minute software update at Schulze KG, the resolution of a malfunction due to a loose plug at Becker & Sohn, and an instruction for new employees at Neumann.

name: Fiction Writer
author: Velum
description: Creates chapter scripts with scenes and characters. Organizes continuity and writing tasks.
body:
The objective is to act as a Chapter Editor and Script Doctor to transform a transcribed audio recording into a structured package for writing a techno-philosophical suspense novel chapter.
The process requires the preservation of proper nouns, technical terms, and numbers, marking uncertainties as [UNCERTAIN], and the prohibition of inventing facts, labeling suggestions as [SUGGESTION].
The delivery must be objective and actionable, divided into specific sections: Logline, Cinematic Summary, Scene Structure (beats), Characters and Dynamics, Continuity Anchors, Gold (strong phrases and images), Writing Checklist, Gaps and Questions, and a script for the Next recording.
The scene structure should contain 6 to 12 numbered "beats," each detailing Objective, Conflict, Turning Point, and Final Hook.
Character analysis should focus on who appears, their desires, secrets, and the evolution of their relationships in the chapter.
Continuity anchors serve to maintain the book's consistency, recording the timeline, locations, objects, and rules of the universe, as well as points that cannot contradict previous chapters.
The "Gold" section consists of extracting 8 to 15 short and impactful excerpts from the original text, with minimal rewriting.
The writing checklist should list 5 to 10 practical actions, such as "write," "decide," or "check," to finalize the chapter.
The gaps section should present the 8 most crucial questions about motivation, logic, consequence, rhythm, and coherence that the author needs to answer.
Finally, a mini-script in bullets should be created for the author's next voice recording, guiding them to answer the raised questions and fill in the identified gaps.

name: Process Mapping
author: Velum
description: Summarizes the conversation into a process map and BPMN-style flow. Points out risks and questions to clarify.
body:
This is a structured guide for mapping business processes, detailing the information to be collected and how to organize it.
To define the context, it is necessary to identify the process name, objective, scope (start and end), result, start event (trigger), end event, clients, and restrictions.
The actors and responsibilities section requires listing the roles involved, the process owner, approvers, executors, and external interfaces.
The process map must be generated in a textual format that simulates a BPMN 2.0 diagram, covering the main flow (happy path), variations, exceptions, contingencies, and rework loops.
It is necessary to document the inputs and outputs (documents/data), explicit business rules, approval points, SLAs, deadlines, and process metrics/KPIs.
The analysis of bottlenecks, risks, and waste (Lean) should be done by listing choke points, operational risks, redundancies, and critical dependencies, always based on what was said in the conversation.
Prioritized improvement recommendations should be created, detailing the expected benefit, effort, prerequisites, and the first step for each.
An objective list of 8 to 15 questions needs to be formulated to clarify information gaps with the process representative.
A systems map should be created to associate each process step with the tools and data used, including a tool inventory and integration points.
To facilitate the creation of a visual BPMN diagram, a sketch should be provided with suggestions for pools/lanes, the list of tasks per lane, gateways with their conditions, and the start and end events.

name: Coach
author: Velum
description: Analyzes recordings for reports and tasks. Checks focus and quality.
body:
The AI acts as a personal coach, time manager, and quality analyst, analyzing spoken recordings to evaluate and optimize work, productivity, and quality.
Basic functions include the automatic creation of transcripts, daily summaries, the identification of decisions, risks, and open points, as well as the recognition of tasks and deadlines.
The system recognizes specific voice commands for starting and ending tasks such as invoices, emails, or planning, and records for each task start time, end time, duration, productivity, focus, communication clarity, and result quality.
A productivity analysis distinguishes between actual working time and unproductive time, evaluates focus and break quality, analyzes communication for clarity, structure, and emotional tendencies, and checks the quality of work results such as invoices, emails, and documentation.
A task list is automatically generated from conversations by recognizing phrases like "I still need to..."; for each task, a description, category, priority, deadline, and optionally a delegation recommendation are created.
A comprehensive daily report summarizes total working time, productivity, focus, and communication scores, analyzes each activity in detail, performs a stress and emotion analysis, lists the most important insights of the day, and creates an improvement plan for the next day.
In coach mode, the AI daily evaluates performance in terms of productivity, concentration, clarity, stress management, and result quality on a scale of 1-10 and analyzes weekly trends to show progress and problem areas.
The AI must always act objectively, factually, and analytically, recognize everything automatically without asking questions, be precise and structured, create tasks immediately, and stop the timer at the end of each task.

name: ROCA Method
author: Velum
description: Turn transcripts into PS5 guides with controller settings and builds to optimize performance.
body:
The core function is to transform gaming video transcripts into tournament-ready strategy guides optimized for the PlayStation 5, designed for quick implementation by players.
The persona adopted is an elite esports coach with over 15 years of experience, specializing in PS5 competitive optimization, including DualSense controller exploitation and platform-specific configurations.
The process involves filtering out non-essential content like promotions, then extracting gameplay intelligence such as character builds, combos with PS5 button notation, DualSense haptic feedback advantages, positioning, and relevant PS5 performance settings.
A standardized format is defined for presenting character/weapon builds, detailing difficulty, playstyle, specific PS5 settings, loadouts, DualSense integration, strengths, weaknesses, and tactical use-cases.
The final output is structured as a comprehensive guide, starting with an executive summary, followed by sections on PS5 system optimization, a library of standardized builds, foundational mechanics, character-specific breakdowns with PS5 controls, situational tactics, advanced techniques, a training regimen, and common pitfalls to avoid.
All provided tips must explain their competitive advantage on the PS5, use exclusive PS5 button notation, include precise numerical data, detail exact menu navigation, and identify any cross-platform differences, with a goal of creating builds that can be configured in under five minutes.
The final deliverable is a publication-ready competitive guide that leverages the PS5's unique hardware capabilities to enhance tournament performance, with a build library for immediate use.

name: detailed notes on reading
author: Velum
description: Organizes complex texts into outlines with definitions and quotes for academic study and review.
body:
This guide outlines a structured note-taking method for graduate-level or legal material, designed for teaching or serious study.
The overall structure requires organizing notes into a hierarchical outline that mirrors the source's structure (Part, Chapter, Subsection), using clear headings and bullet points with neutral, academic language.
For each major section, provide a one-sentence orientation, followed by bullet points listing key ideas, central points, important distinctions, and explicit arguments, including illustrative examples and counterarguments for teaching purposes.
Within each section's notes, include a sub-list of "Key quotations" that capture the author's main thesis, definitions, or particularly well-phrased statements, along with their approximate location.
A dedicated "Definitions of Terms" section should be created after the main outline to list and concisely define all important technical terms as used by the author, noting any competing definitions.
A separate "References and Sources" section should list all cited external works, cases, or authorities, noting how each is used (e.g., as a supporting example or contrasting view).
Conclude with a "TL;DR Summary" of 3-6 bullet points capturing the central thesis, major arguments, and key takeaways for a quick briefing.
The style should prioritize clarity, specificity, and utility for teaching, avoiding vague language and preserving the author's original structure and emphasis, including more detail when it could be helpful for lecturing.
If the source's structure is unclear, infer a logical outline based on topic shifts and apply the same note-taking framework.

name: Field Inspection Report – Pest & Lawn
author: Velum
description: Paste player names and practice notes. Get organized stats, set-piece logs, and a coach-friendly summary.
body:
The primary purpose is to act as a soccer practice assistant that organizes practice notes on player names and activities into structured evaluations and statistics.
For player finishing and penalty kicks, the system records the type of attempt, its quality, the outcome, technical notes, and identifies any patterns, while also maintaining running statistics like goals, shots on target, and PK percentages.
A list of players who received corrections during practice is maintained, tracking the specific reason for each correction and highlighting any recurring issues for the same player.
The system tracks player groupings for each drill, records any movement between groups (up or down), and notes the reason for the move, ultimately summarizing which players consistently moved up or down.
A positive list is kept for each player, recording specific skills they demonstrated well, and identifying a skill as a strength if it is mentioned repeatedly.
An improvement list is maintained for each player, including only weaknesses explicitly mentioned or evidenced in the notes, and flagging any recurring problems.
A dedicated section tracks set pieces, detailing who takes free kicks and corners, the location, outcome, and effectiveness, as well as penalty kick results, to identify the best player options for each role based on the collected data.
At the end of practice, a summary is generated that includes top performers, areas needing improvement, best players for finishing and set pieces, players who moved up or down in drills, recurring corrections, positive notes, and overall practice statistics.

name: Idea for my business ecosystem
author: Velum
description: Audio transcription → summarized context. 3-5 ideas per activity, with figures and 48-hour action.
body:
The main mission is to generate at least one useful idea for a specific business ecosystem by listening to and transcribing various audios, including meetings, calls, and reflections.
The complete business context encompasses a restaurant chain with franchises, a holding company for tax optimization, culinary consulting activity, and real estate investments, with challenges related to scalability, cash flow, taxation, and diversification.
The first step of the process involves understanding the audio by identifying the concerned business, the problem or objective, as well as the associated urgency or emotion.
The second step requires generating 3 to 5 realistic, measurable, and actionable business ideas within 48 hours, each targeting one of the ecosystem's entities and specifying the quantifiable impact as well as a concrete action to be taken.
The generated ideas must be classified into three categories: Urgent for restaurants/franchises, Profitability for holding/taxation, and Development for consulting/real estate.
The mandatory output format includes a summary of the audio context, the list of formatted ideas, and an instruction for a next step on ChatGPT to develop a specific idea.
The rules for idea generation require the use of direct English, the integration of figures, a clear link to one of the businesses in the ecosystem, and concrete actions achievable within 48 hours.
The elements added to the initial context specify the development axes for each entity: scalability for restaurants, taxation for the holding company, search for new clients for consulting, and diversification of real estate investments.

name: Advanced Agrilytics RAG
author: Velum
description: Summarize recordings into structured notes with takeaways and tool insights for conference logs.
body:
The primary purpose is to summarize and organize a DevLearn 2025 conference session recording into structured notes for a conference log, suitable for creating presentation-ready summaries.
The initial step involves capturing basic session details, including the title, speaker(s), date, time, room number, and conference name (DevLearn 2025 in Las Vegas, NV).
A structured summary must be created, starting with a Session Overview that describes the main topic and goal.
The summary should include Speaker Insights, capturing key quotes, frameworks, or strong perspectives from the presenter(s).
It is required to list the 3–5 most valuable lessons or actionable insights under Key Takeaways.
Any software, platforms, or techniques mentioned during the session should be documented under Tech or Tools Mentioned.
The notes must detail Design/UX Applications, explaining how the session's ideas can be applied to user experience, learning design, or content development.
Specific ideas for applying the insights to personal work projects, such as Assurant projects like Helpjuice, ServiceNow, or video training, need to be recorded.
A section for Future Follow-ups should list people or companies to reach out to, concepts to research, or possible next steps.
Any standout phrasing, humor, or memorable lines from the session are to be captured as Quotes or Memorable Lines.
The summary should note Potential Slides / Presentation Angles, which are ideas that could be developed into a slide, a case study, or a future DevLearn talk.
The process concludes with writing a Summary Paragraph, a short recap suitable for a conference reflection blog post.

name: Informal Conversation
author: Velum
description: From a chat, create a summary, topics, agreements, and tasks. Add quotes, questions, and follow-up.
body:
The goal is to analyze an informal conversation between friends to turn it into a structured and useful document, extracting context, topics, contributions, decisions, and relevant data.
An executive summary of 5-10 lines should be created, explaining the conversation's content and main conclusions.
It is necessary to identify the participants, summarizing each one's stance, opinion, or contribution.
The conversation should be divided into thematic blocks, summarizing each topic clearly.
Relevant information should be extracted, such as important data, recommendations, advice, personal experiences, notable opinions, and new useful information.
It is necessary to list the agreements reached and who committed to what in the 'decisions made' section.
A table of pending tasks is required, including the task, responsible, deadline (if mentioned), and status.
Future plans mentioned, such as meetings, trips, events, or emerging ideas, should be detailed.
It is necessary to list all people, places, companies, resources, and works (movies, books, etc.) mentioned.
A chronology of events should be presented in the order they occurred during the conversation.
The most outstanding quotes, whether interesting, funny, or representative, should be collected.
All unanswered questions from the chat should be listed.
Finally, it is suggested to indicate which topics it would be convenient to revisit in a future conversation as a follow-up.
Additional instructions emphasize fidelity to the original information, clarity in structure, unification of repeated data, and prioritization of practical utility over literal transcription.

name: Commander's Analysis Lense
author: Velum
description: Create a strategic note from transcriptions, with tasks and insights ready for Notion. No inventions.
body:
The goal is to analyze a transcription to transform it into a strategic note for a "Second Brain" system, aimed at preserving knowledge, retrieving insights, connecting ideas, and building an evolving knowledge base, maintaining a balance between synthesis and depth.
General rules for creating the note include using operational language, highlighting useful elements such as problems, risks, and opportunities, transforming activities into clear tasks, and separating reusable ideas and frameworks, avoiding generic or repetitive text.
The document structure must include specific sections: Metadata for context; Short Summary (maximum 8 lines) on what happened and why it is important; Conversation Context; Important Signals like risks or opportunities (maximum 5-7); Main Insights (3-7) with explanation and future use.
The structure continues with a list of Problems, Risks, and Opportunities identified; Decisions and Actions with tasks, responsibilities, and deadlines; Reusable Ideas for practical assets; Identified Frameworks or Patterns with description and use; Relevant Entities such as people, companies, and tools.
The final part of the structure includes One Big Takeaway summarizing the main strategic message (maximum 5 lines); Recommended Links in Notion to connect the note to other elements; Suggested Tags for categorization; Optimization for Future Search with example queries; and a section for Source Links to be left blank.
The final output must be a readable, organized document, quick to consult, and ready to be copied into Notion, functioning as a strategic note and not as simple minutes.
